title: 北京國家體育場~Beijing National Stadium
focus: 以 24 組桁架柱支承、12 m 深交織平面桁架構成的空間門式鋼屋蓋，及其節點、臨時支撐與分級卸載~A portalised steel roof of interlaced 12 m deep plane trusses on 24 column trusses, its nodes, falsework and staged unloading
summary: 北京國家體育場（鳥巢）把屋蓋、立面與樓梯整合成一個由交織平面桁架構成的鋼結構外殼，屋蓋平面約 313 m × 266 m，與內部混凝土看台結構完全分離。課程從空間門式結構與三級地震性能目標出發，處理 1.2 m 箱形桿件的板厚與扭曲面、複雜節點的原型試驗、78 個臨時支撐點上的分段組裝與分級卸載，再談溫度與施工監測、ETFE 與 PTFE 雙層膜、防蝕排水維護與賽後再利用。~The Beijing National Stadium, the Bird's Nest, merges roof, façade and stairs into one steel shell of interlaced plane trusses, about 313 m × 266 m on plan and fully separated from the concrete seating bowl inside. The course starts from the portalised space-truss system and three-level seismic performance targets, then covers plate thickness and twisted surfaces of 1.2 m box members, prototype tests of congested nodes, sectional assembly and staged unloading on 78 temporary support points, thermal and construction monitoring, the double ETFE and PTFE membranes, corrosion and drainage maintenance and post-Games reuse.

units.anchor: 12 m 深主桁架網~12 m deep primary truss grid
units.title: 交織平面桁架的空間門式結構~A portalised space truss of interlaced plane trusses
units.mechanism: 鳥巢屋蓋的主結構是一組組深約 12 m 的平面桁架，彼此交織成網，跨越約 313 m × 266 m 的平面並升高到約 60 m；桁架落在外圍 24 組桁架柱上，柱與桁架剛接形成三維門式構架，同時抵抗重力與側向力。看似隨機的立面桿件多屬次結構，依旋轉平面規則細分主網格，並與樓梯整合。2004 年取消可開合屋頂後，中央開口得以加大，主桁架跨度與用鋼量隨之下降。內部混凝土看台與鋼外殼相距約 15 m，兩者結構獨立，各自承擔自身的地震與溫度作用。~The primary roof structure is a set of plane trusses about 12 m deep that interlace into a web, spanning about 313 m × 266 m on plan and rising to about 60 m; the trusses land on 24 perimeter column trusses, rigidly connected so that columns and trusses form a three-dimensional portal frame resisting both gravity and lateral load. Most of the seemingly random façade members are secondary structure that subdivides the primary grid by rules of rotated planes and is integrated with the stairs. Dropping the retractable roof in 2004 allowed a larger central opening, reducing primary truss spans and steel. The concrete seating bowl stands roughly 15 m inside the steel shell and is structurally independent, each carrying its own earthquake and thermal actions.
units.model: 以簡支類比估算主桁架弦桿力：線荷載 w = 5 kPa × 12 m 受荷寬度 = 60 kN/m，等效跨度 L = 150 m，M = wL²/8 = 60×150²/8 ≈ 168,750 kN·m；桁架深 d = 12 m 時弦桿力 C = M/d ≈ 14,100 kN。若深度降為原可開合屋頂桁架的 8.2 m，C ≈ 20,600 kN，增加約 46%。荷載、受荷寬度與等效跨度為教學假設。~A simply supported analogy estimates the primary truss chord force: line load w = 5 kPa × 12 m tributary width = 60 kN/m over an equivalent span L = 150 m gives M = wL²/8 = 60×150²/8 ≈ 168,750 kN·m; with depth d = 12 m the chord force is C = M/d ≈ 14,100 kN. Reducing the depth to the 8.2 m of the former retractable-roof trusses raises C to about 20,600 kN, about 46% more. Load, tributary width and equivalent span are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以整體三維模型做靜力、模態與施工階段分析，抽出每一主桁架的弦桿軸力與彎矩，與手算類比比較數量級；確認 24 個主支承節點的反力分配合理，並檢查次結構在模型中是否被錯誤地當成主要傳力路徑。~Run static, modal and construction-stage analyses on the global three-dimensional model, extract chord axial forces and moments of every primary truss and compare their order of magnitude with the hand analogy; confirm that reactions are reasonably distributed among the 24 primary support nodes, and check that the secondary structure is not wrongly acting as a main load path in the model.
units.failure: 若把立面次結構與主桁架以同等勁度建模，荷載會被分配到不該承重的細部桿件，實際施工後次結構過度受力、節點開裂；反之若忽略次結構對主桁架的約束，挫屈長度會被高估或低估，構件尺寸失去依據。~Modelling façade secondary members with the same stiffness as primary trusses sends load into minor members not meant to carry it, overstressing them and cracking nodes after construction; ignoring the restraint they provide to the primary trusses misjudges buckling lengths, so member sizing loses its basis.
units.misconception: 鳥巢的鋼構件是隨機排列的，每根桿件都同樣承重。~The Bird's Nest members are randomly arranged and every member carries load equally.
units.practice: 結構圖說與模型應明確標示主結構、次結構與非結構桿件三種層級，並為每一層級訂定不同的性能目標、檢驗等級與焊接要求；建築造型調整時，先確認是否動到主結構網格。~Drawings and models should clearly label primary, secondary and non-structural members, with separate performance targets, inspection grades and welding requirements for each level; when the architectural form changes, first confirm whether the primary grid is affected.

units.anchor: 三級地震性能目標~Three-level seismic targets
units.title: 高烈度區的性能化耐震設計~Performance-based seismic design in a high-intensity zone
units.mechanism: 北京屬 8 度設防區，50 年超越機率 10% 的地表加速度約 0.2g。Arup 為屋蓋訂定三級性能：50 年、500 年與 2,500 年回歸期地震；最高等級以非線性歷時分析檢核，主結構保持彈性或接近彈性，次結構允許嚴重損傷但不得倒塌。巨大的鋼屋蓋質量在地震時產生可觀慣性力，必須經由 24 組桁架柱傳到基礎，因此柱腳與柱頂節點是耐震設計的關鍵。~Beijing lies in seismic intensity zone VIII, with a peak ground acceleration of about 0.2g for a 10% probability of exceedance in 50 years. Arup set three performance levels for the roof, for 50-, 500- and 2,500-year return-period earthquakes; the highest level was checked by nonlinear response-history analysis, keeping primary members elastic or nearly elastic while allowing severe damage but no collapse in secondary members. The large mass of the steel roof generates considerable inertia forces that must pass through the 24 column trusses to the foundations, so column bases and column-top nodes are the critical seismic details.
units.model: 依 GB 50011，8 度（0.20g）多遇地震水平影響係數最大值 α_max = 0.16、罕遇地震為 0.90。若屋蓋與立面鋼結構重量 W = 400,000 kN，平台段基底剪力 V = 0.16×400,000 = 64,000 kN，平均每組桁架柱約 2,670 kN；罕遇地震 0.90 時每組約 15,000 kN，是多遇地震的 5.6 倍。結構重量與平台段假設為教學假設。~Under GB 50011, the maximum horizontal seismic coefficient for intensity VIII (0.20g) is α_max = 0.16 for frequent earthquakes and 0.90 for rare earthquakes. With a roof and façade steel weight W = 400,000 kN on the spectral plateau, the base shear is V = 0.16×400,000 = 64,000 kN, about 2,670 kN per column truss; with 0.90 for a rare earthquake it is about 15,000 kN per column, 5.6 times larger. Structural weight and plateau response are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以至少三組強震紀錄做非線性歷時分析，統計主構件的需求／容量比是否小於 1、次構件的塑性轉角是否在允許範圍；以反應譜分析與歷時分析的基底剪力互相校核，並檢查 24 組柱的剪力分配與柱腳錨定在最不利方向的受力。~Run nonlinear response-history analyses with at least three sets of strong-motion records, checking that primary demand/capacity ratios stay below 1 and secondary plastic rotations within limits; cross-check base shear from response-spectrum and response-history analyses, and check the shear distribution among the 24 columns and the column-base anchorage forces in the most adverse direction.
units.failure: 若未對主次結構區分性能等級，罕遇地震時可能是關鍵柱頂節點先降伏，屋蓋失去門式構架作用而大幅變位；若鋼屋蓋與混凝土看台之間的間隙不足，兩者在地震中碰撞，造成看台邊緣與鋼柱局部損壞。~Without separate performance levels for primary and secondary structure, critical column-top nodes may yield first in a rare earthquake, so the roof loses its portal action and displaces heavily; insufficient clearance between steel roof and concrete bowl lets the two pound together, locally damaging bowl edges and steel columns.
units.misconception: 大型鋼屋蓋重量輕，地震力很小，可以只做風載設計。~A large steel roof is light, so earthquake forces are small and wind design alone suffices.
units.practice: 性能化設計報告應列出每級地震的性能目標、所用地震紀錄、構件分級與接受準則，並經專家審查會確認；鋼外殼與看台之間的淨距須在施工圖上標示為不得占用的耐震間隙。~The performance-based design report should list targets for each earthquake level, records used, member classification and acceptance criteria, confirmed by an expert review panel; the clearance between steel shell and bowl should be marked on construction drawings as a seismic gap that must not be obstructed.

units.anchor: 1.2 m 箱形桿件~1.2 m box members
units.title: 箱形桿件板厚與可展扭曲面~Box-member plate thickness and developable twisted surfaces
units.mechanism: 主桁架與立面桿件外形統一為約 1.2 m 見方的箱形斷面，板厚由 8 mm 到 100 mm，多數小於 70 mm；為了節省成本，部分上弦改為 1.0 m 見方。耐震緊湊斷面要求寬厚比約 b/t ≤ 16，若全面照此要求，板厚需約 70 mm，因此設計須區分哪些桿件需要高韌性。立面上的扭曲箱形桿件以可展曲面構成，能由平板切割後彎捲成形，避免昂貴的三維壓製。厚板也帶來層狀撕裂與焊接殘餘應力的問題，需要指定厚度方向性能。~Primary truss and façade members share an external box profile of about 1.2 m square, with plates from 8 mm to 100 mm, most under 70 mm; some top chords were reduced to 1.0 m square to save cost. Seismically compact sections need a width-to-thickness ratio of about b/t ≤ 16, which would mean plates of about 70 mm everywhere, so the design had to distinguish which members needed high ductility. Twisted façade boxes were formed from developable surfaces, so they could be cut from flat plate and rolled rather than pressed in three dimensions at high cost. Thick plates also bring lamellar tearing and welding residual stress, requiring specified through-thickness properties.
units.model: 1.2 m 見方箱形斷面面積 A = 1.2² − (1.2 − 2t)²。t = 40 mm 時 A = 1.44 − 1.12² ≈ 0.186 m²，單位重約 0.186×7,850 ≈ 1,460 kg/m，b/t = 1,200/40 = 30；t = 70 mm 時 A ≈ 0.316 m²、約 2,480 kg/m，重 1.7 倍。滿足 b/t ≤ 16 需 t ≥ 1,200/16 = 75 mm。以外寬近似寬厚比為教學簡化。~A 1.2 m square box has area A = 1.2² − (1.2 − 2t)². For t = 40 mm, A = 1.44 − 1.12² ≈ 0.186 m², about 0.186×7,850 ≈ 1,460 kg/m, with b/t = 1,200/40 = 30; for t = 70 mm, A ≈ 0.316 m², about 2,480 kg/m, 1.7 times heavier. Meeting b/t ≤ 16 needs t ≥ 1,200/16 = 75 mm. Using the outer width for b/t is a teaching simplification.
units.verify: 厚板進場時核對材質證明的強度、衝擊韌性與厚度方向斷面收縮率，以超音波檢測夾層；扭曲構件在工廠以三維量測比對設計曲面，焊後量測扭轉角與端面位置；全滲透焊縫依規定比例做超音波探傷，厚板焊接記錄預熱與層間溫度。~On delivery check mill certificates of thick plates for strength, impact toughness and through-thickness reduction of area, and test for laminations by ultrasound; measure twisted members in the shop by three-dimensional survey against the design surface, and after welding check twist angle and end positions; test complete-penetration welds ultrasonically at the specified rate, recording preheat and interpass temperatures for thick plates.
units.failure: 厚板在承受厚度方向拉力的 T 形接頭處，若鋼材厚度方向性能不足，焊接收縮會造成層狀撕裂，裂縫隱藏在板內；扭曲構件若用非可展曲面強行冷彎，殘餘應力與局部皺褶會降低挫屈強度，也使現場對接困難。~At T-joints that pull thick plates through their thickness, steel without adequate through-thickness properties can suffer lamellar tearing from weld shrinkage, cracks hidden inside the plate; forcing a non-developable twist by cold bending leaves residual stress and local wrinkling that reduce buckling strength and make site joints hard to fit.
units.misconception: 所有桿件外形都是 1.2 m 方管，所以斷面與板厚都一樣。~All members look like 1.2 m boxes, so their sections and plate thicknesses are the same.
units.practice: 構件清單要逐件標明板厚、鋼種、厚度方向等級與是否屬耐震緊湊斷面，並把扭曲面的展開圖納入製造圖；厚板焊接程序須經評定試驗，由焊接工程師與結構設計者共同核可。~The member schedule should state plate thickness, steel grade, through-thickness class and whether each member is a seismically compact section, with developed patterns of twisted surfaces included in the fabrication drawings; thick-plate welding procedures must be qualified by test and approved jointly by the welding engineer and structural designer.

units.anchor: 雙 K 節點與柱頂節點~Double-K and column-top nodes
units.title: 複雜節點的局部應力與縮尺原型試驗~Congested-node stress and scaled prototype tests
units.mechanism: 鳥巢的傳力依賴大量節點，梁、柱與樓梯在節點處以不同角度匯集，箱形壁板在交會處產生應力集中與局部彎曲。設計以有限元素分析檢查彎曲構件與擁擠節點，調整局部加厚與加勁板位置以降低尖峰應力，再以試驗驗證：1:2.5 的彎折桁架與扭曲薄壁箱形構件在清華大學試驗，雙 K 節點與柱頂節點在同濟大學試驗，鋼構廠也以 40 mm 鋼板做了一個足尺節點樣品，檢查焊接可行性。~Load transfer in the Bird's Nest depends on many nodes where beams, columns and stairs meet at varied angles, so box walls see stress concentrations and local bending at intersections. The design checked curved members and congested nodes with finite-element analysis, adjusting local thickening and stiffener positions to reduce peak stress, then verified them by testing: 1:2.5 elbow trusses and twisted thin-walled boxes at Tsinghua University, double-K nodes and column tops at Tongji University, and a full-scale node mock-up in 40 mm plate built by the steel fabricator to check welding feasibility.
units.model: 幾何縮尺 1:2.5 的鋼模型若要重現相同應力，荷載須按面積比縮小：F_m = F_p/2.5² = 0.16F_p。足尺節點設計力 20 MN 時，試驗荷載約 3.2 MN；足尺 40 mm 板在模型中為 40/2.5 = 16 mm。焊縫尺寸與殘餘應力不按比例縮放，是縮尺試驗的主要限制。設計力為教學假設。~To reproduce full-scale stress in a 1:2.5 steel model, loads scale with area: F_m = F_p/2.5² = 0.16F_p. A full-scale node force of 20 MN corresponds to a test load of about 3.2 MN, and a 40 mm full-scale plate becomes 40/2.5 = 16 mm in the model. Weld sizes and residual stresses do not scale, the main limitation of scaled tests. The design force is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 試驗前以有限元素模型預測應變分布與極限荷載，在高應力區貼應變花；加載至設計荷載與極限荷載，比較量測應變、變形與破壞模式；若破壞位置與預測不同，須回頭修正模型與加勁配置，而不是只看極限荷載是否夠大。~Before testing, predict strain distribution and ultimate load with the finite-element model and place rosettes in high-stress zones; load to design and ultimate levels and compare measured strains, deformations and failure mode; if failure occurs where it was not predicted, revise the model and stiffener layout rather than simply checking that the ultimate load is high enough.
units.failure: 擁擠節點內加勁板過多會讓焊工無法到達根部，形成未熔合與高殘餘應力，反而成為裂縫起點；只用梁單元模型而不做節點細部分析，可能遺漏箱形壁板的局部挫屈或撕裂。~Too many stiffeners inside a congested node leave welders unable to reach the root, creating lack of fusion and high residual stress that become crack initiators; using only beam-element models without detailed node analysis can miss local buckling or tearing of box walls.
units.misconception: 節點只要比桿件強就安全，不需要另外做分析或試驗。~A node is safe as long as it is stronger than the members, so no separate analysis or test is needed.
units.practice: 節點設計要同時檢查受力與可焊性：每個加勁板都要有焊接可達的路徑與順序，複雜節點先做足尺樣品評估製造性；試驗報告與修正後的節點圖須由結構設計者簽認後才能大量製造。~Node design must check both force flow and weldability: every stiffener needs an accessible welding path and sequence, and complex nodes should be mocked up at full scale to assess fabrication; test reports and revised node drawings must be signed by the structural designer before production.

units.anchor: 78 個臨時支撐點~78 temporary support points
units.title: 分段組裝與臨時支撐胎架~Sectional assembly on temporary falsework
units.mechanism: 主桁架在完成閉合前無法自承，因此依四個階段施工：先立 24 組桁架柱、立面次結構、中間環桁架與分段主桁架並由臨時支撐承托；主桁架分段組裝完成後再移除臨時支撐；接著安裝頂面次結構與立面樓梯；最後安裝天溝、步道、照明與排水。分析中設置 78 個臨時支撐點，每一點的反力與標高都影響桁架對接精度與最終應力狀態。分段大小由吊機能力、運輸限制與焊接位置決定，接口應避開高應力區。~The primary trusses cannot carry themselves until closed, so construction followed four phases: first the 24 column trusses, façade secondary structure, middle ring trusses and primary truss sections on temporary supports; then removal of the temporary supports after the primary trusses were assembled; then the top-surface secondary structure and façade stairs; finally gutters, catwalks, lighting and drainage. The analysis used 78 temporary support points, and the reaction and level at each point affect fit-up accuracy and the final stress state. Section size is set by crane capacity, transport limits and weld locations, with joints placed away from high-stress zones.
units.model: 若主桁架與環桁架在卸載前的總重為 30,000 t，平均每個支撐點承托 30,000/78 ≈ 385 t（約 3,770 kN）；考慮分布不均取放大係數 2.0，設計反力約 770 t。若支撐胎架頂沉陷 10 mm、桁架在該點的勁度為 15 kN/mm，則反力重新分配約 150 kN。重量、放大係數與勁度為教學假設。~If the primary and ring trusses weigh 30,000 t before unloading, each support point carries on average 30,000/78 ≈ 385 t (about 3,770 kN); with a non-uniformity factor of 2.0 the design reaction is about 770 t. If a falsework head settles 10 mm and the truss stiffness at that point is 15 kN/mm, about 150 kN is redistributed. Weight, factor and stiffness are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每個胎架做基礎承載、柱身挫屈與頂部調整裝置檢核，安裝前量測其頂標高；分段吊上後以全測站量測對接口的三維座標，誤差在允許範圍內才焊接，焊後再量測，並把胎架反力（千斤頂讀值）與施工階段分析的預測值比對。~Check each falsework tower for foundation capacity, shaft buckling and head-adjustment device, and survey its head level before installation; after a section is lifted, survey the three-dimensional coordinates of its joints and weld only within tolerance, re-survey after welding, and compare falsework reactions from jack readings with the construction-stage prediction.
units.failure: 胎架基礎設在未壓實的回填土上，在重載與降雨後不均勻沉陷，桁架對接口錯位，強行對焊會鎖入額外應力；若吊裝順序與分析不同，某些胎架承受遠超設計的反力而挫屈，可能引發連鎖崩落。~Falsework footings on poorly compacted fill settle unevenly under heavy load and rain, misaligning truss joints so forced fit-up welding locks in extra stress; if the lifting sequence departs from the analysis, some towers carry far more than their design reaction and buckle, possibly triggering progressive collapse.
units.misconception: 臨時支撐只是施工用，不需要像永久結構一樣計算與檢查。~Temporary supports are only for construction and need no calculation or inspection like permanent structure.
units.practice: 臨時支撐系統應有獨立的設計計算書、基礎檢查與每日標高紀錄；吊裝順序變更必須回到施工階段分析重新確認，未經結構設計者同意不得更改，這是停止點而非現場自行判斷事項。~The temporary support system needs its own design calculations, foundation inspection and daily level records; any change in lifting sequence must go back to the construction-stage analysis and must not proceed without the structural designer's agreement, a hold point rather than a site decision.

units.anchor: 同步分級卸載~Synchronised staged unloading
units.title: 卸載：把荷載從胎架轉移到結構~Unloading: transferring load from falsework to structure
units.mechanism: 主桁架完成閉合後，原本由胎架承托的重量要轉移到 24 組桁架柱上，這個體系轉換稱為卸載。卸載時屋蓋整體下沉，各點下沉量不同，若某一支撐比相鄰支撐慢，它就會分擔額外重量；若太快，鄰近支撐和桁架會突然加載。因此卸載採用多台液壓千斤頂、按施工階段分析預測的位移分成多級同步下降，每級停下量測並比對，確認結構已按預期接手荷載後才進入下一級。~After the primary trusses close, the weight carried by the falsework must be transferred to the 24 column trusses, a system change called unloading. The roof settles as a whole by different amounts at each point; a support that lags its neighbours picks up extra weight, and one that drops too fast suddenly loads adjacent supports and trusses. Unloading therefore uses many hydraulic jacks lowered synchronously in stages according to displacements predicted by construction-stage analysis, stopping after each stage to measure and compare, and proceeding only when the structure has taken load as expected.
units.model: 某支撐點預測總下沉 270 mm，分 10 級、每級 27 mm。若該點千斤頂落後一級而相鄰點已下降，該點相對位移差 Δ = 27 mm，桁架在此處勁度 k = 15 kN/mm，附加反力 ΔR = k·Δ = 405 kN，約為平均反力 3,770 kN 的 11%。下沉量、級數與勁度為教學假設。~A support point is predicted to settle 270 mm in total, unloaded in 10 stages of 27 mm. If its jack lags one stage behind its neighbours, the relative displacement Δ = 27 mm with a truss stiffness k = 15 kN/mm adds ΔR = k·Δ = 405 kN, about 11% of the average 3,770 kN reaction. Settlement, number of stages and stiffness are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 卸載前確認所有焊縫檢驗完成、臨時連接已拆除或解除約束；每級量測千斤頂壓力、支撐點下沉、關鍵桿件應變與溫度，與分析預測比較，偏差超過預設門檻（例如位移 15% 或反力 10%）即停止並由設計者評估；卸載完成後量測完整的屋蓋幾何作為基準。~Before unloading confirm that all weld inspections are complete and temporary connections removed or released; at each stage record jack pressures, support settlements, strains in key members and temperatures, compare with predictions, and stop for the designer's assessment when deviation exceeds preset limits such as 15% in displacement or 10% in reaction; after unloading survey the complete roof geometry as a baseline.
units.failure: 千斤頂未同步或量測只看單點，會讓個別支撐或桁架在卸載途中超載；忘記拆除某處臨時連接，結構在該處被拉住，形成設計外的受力路徑。卸載在一天中溫差大的時段進行，量到的位移混入溫度變形，可能誤判結構狀態。~Unsynchronised jacks or single-point monitoring can overload individual supports or trusses mid-unloading; a forgotten temporary connection holds the structure back and creates an unintended load path. Unloading during large daily temperature swings mixes thermal movement into measured displacement and can lead to a wrong judgment of the structure's state.
units.misconception: 卸載就是把臨時支撐拆掉，順序與速度不重要。~Unloading just means removing temporary supports; order and speed do not matter.
units.practice: 卸載方案須列明分級、每級目標位移、停止準則、量測項目與決策流程，由施工單位、監測單位與結構設計者共同簽認；卸載期間設警戒區，並選在溫度穩定的時段進行。~The unloading plan must state stages, target displacement per stage, stop criteria, measurements and decision route, signed jointly by the contractor, the monitoring team and the structural designer; set an exclusion zone during unloading and carry it out when temperatures are stable.

units.anchor: 溫度與應變監測點~Temperature and strain monitoring points
units.title: 溫度作用與施工監測~Thermal action and construction monitoring
units.mechanism: 鳥巢的鋼外殼連續而未設大量伸縮縫，北京冬冷夏熱，八月屋蓋鋼構件表面溫度可達約 47°C；溫度變化會使整個鋼殼膨脹收縮，受柱與節點約束時產生附加內力。因此設計要決定合攏（閉合）溫度，並在施工中監測鋼構件溫度、應變與節點座標。應變計讀數同時包含荷載與溫度效應，需要溫度補償；量測時間最好選在日出前，鋼構溫度最均勻的時刻。~The steel shell is continuous without many movement joints, and Beijing has cold winters and hot summers, with roof steel reaching about 47°C on an August day; temperature change makes the whole shell expand and contract, and restraint by columns and nodes creates additional internal forces. The design therefore sets a closure temperature, and steel temperature, strain and node coordinates are monitored during construction. Strain-gauge readings include both load and thermal effects and need temperature compensation, and surveys are best taken before sunrise when steel temperature is most uniform.
units.model: 鋼的線膨脹係數 α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C，若合攏溫度 15°C、夏季構件 47°C，ΔT = 32°C，313 m 長度的自由伸長 ΔL = αLΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×313,000×32 ≈ 120 mm；完全受約束時應力 σ = EαΔT = 200,000×12×10⁻⁶×32 ≈ 77 MPa。合攏溫度與完全約束為教學假設。~Steel's coefficient α = 12×10⁻⁶ /°C; with a closure temperature of 15°C and members at 47°C in summer, ΔT = 32°C and the free expansion over 313 m is ΔL = αLΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×313,000×32 ≈ 120 mm; fully restrained, the stress would be σ = EαΔT = 200,000×12×10⁻⁶×32 ≈ 77 MPa. The closure temperature and full restraint are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在代表性主桁架弦桿、柱頂與柱腳布設振弦式應變計與溫度計，在卸載前建立零點；每日固定時段量測，扣除溫度效應後與施工階段分析比較，並以全測站量測節點座標的季節變化，確認合攏溫度假設與實際一致。~Install vibrating-wire strain gauges and thermometers on representative primary chords, column tops and column bases, zeroing them before unloading; measure at fixed times each day, remove thermal effects and compare with construction-stage analysis, and survey seasonal changes of node coordinates by total station to confirm that the closure-temperature assumption matches reality.
units.failure: 在高溫午後焊接合攏口，冬季收縮時合攏處受到很大拉力，可能造成焊縫裂紋；應變資料若未做溫度補償，會把日夜溫差誤判為結構荷載變化，導致錯誤的安全判斷。~Welding a closure joint on a hot afternoon puts it under large tension when the steel contracts in winter, possibly cracking the weld; strain data without temperature compensation mistake day–night temperature swings for structural load changes and lead to wrong safety judgments.
units.misconception: 鋼構屋蓋只要強度夠，溫度變化只會造成小變形，不會產生內力。~If a steel roof is strong enough, temperature change only causes small movements and no internal forces.
units.practice: 施工規範應訂定合攏溫度範圍與合攏時段，並要求監測系統在卸載前完成零點校正；監測報告須同時呈現溫度、應變與位移，並註明是否已做溫度修正，由監測單位與設計者共同解讀。~The specification should set the closure temperature range and time window and require the monitoring system to be zeroed before unloading; monitoring reports must present temperature, strain and displacement together and state whether thermal correction was applied, interpreted jointly by the monitoring team and designer.

units.anchor: ETFE 與 PTFE 雙層膜~ETFE and PTFE double membrane
units.title: 雙層膜材的受力、試驗與驗收~Double-membrane behaviour, testing and acceptance
units.mechanism: 鳥巢屋面在鋼構網格上方鋪單層透明 ETFE 膜，約 38,000 m²、約 1,000 片，面積從 1 m² 到 230 m²；下方另有單層半透明 PTFE 吸音天花，約 53,000 m²、約 800 片，兩層相距約 13 m。外層 ETFE 承受雨雪與風壓並把荷載傳到鋼網格，內層 PTFE 主要提供吸音與遮光。膜材在受力時以曲率與預張力抵抗面外荷載，曲率太小就會產生大變形與積水，因此每片膜的形狀、預張力與排水坡度必須一併設計與驗收。~Above the steel grid the roof carries single-layer transparent ETFE, about 38,000 m² in about 1,000 panels from 1 m² to 230 m²; below it a single-layer translucent PTFE acoustic ceiling covers about 53,000 m² in about 800 panels, the two layers about 13 m apart. The outer ETFE carries rain, snow and wind and passes load to the steel grid, while the inner PTFE mainly provides sound absorption and light diffusion. A membrane resists out-of-plane load through curvature and pretension; too little curvature means large deformation and ponding, so the shape, pretension and drainage slope of each panel must be designed and accepted together.
units.model: 單向彎曲膜片的張力 T = p·R，其中 R = L²/(8f) + f/2。取 L = 4 m、垂度 f = 0.3 m，R = 16/2.4 + 0.15 ≈ 6.82 m；壓力 p = 0.5 kPa 時 T ≈ 3.4 kN/m，厚 0.25 mm 的 ETFE 膜應力約 3.4/0.25 ≈ 13.6 MPa。若垂度減半為 0.15 m，R ≈ 13.4 m，T 約加倍。尺寸與荷載為教學假設。~For a singly curved membrane strip, tension T = p·R with R = L²/(8f) + f/2. With L = 4 m and sag f = 0.3 m, R = 16/2.4 + 0.15 ≈ 6.82 m; at p = 0.5 kPa, T ≈ 3.4 kN/m and the stress in 0.25 mm ETFE is about 3.4/0.25 ≈ 13.6 MPa. Halving the sag to 0.15 m gives R ≈ 13.4 m and roughly doubles T. Dimensions and load are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 膜材進場以批號抽樣做單軸與雙軸拉伸、撕裂與高溫潛變試驗，與規格值比較；安裝後量測每片膜的垂度或曲率與邊緣張力，進行淋水試驗確認無積水點；PTFE 天花另以吸音係數試驗與燈光透射量測驗收。~Sample delivered membrane by batch for uniaxial and biaxial tension, tear and elevated-temperature creep tests against the specification; after installation measure each panel's sag or curvature and edge tension and run a water test to confirm there are no ponding points; accept the PTFE ceiling additionally by sound-absorption tests and light-transmission measurement.
units.failure: 曲率不足的膜片在雨雪中下垂積水，積水使變形更大，形成漸進式積水，最後膜片撕裂；ETFE 在高溫下強度降低，若邊緣夾具處有尖角或應力集中，會在夏季強風時從邊緣開始撕裂。~A panel with too little curvature sags and ponds in rain or snow, the water increases the sag, and progressive ponding finally tears it; ETFE loses strength at high temperature, so sharp corners or stress concentrations at edge clamps can start tears from the edge in summer storms.
units.misconception: 膜材越平越好看，只要材料夠強就不需要曲率。~The flatter a membrane the better it looks, and it needs no curvature if the material is strong enough.
units.practice: 每片膜都要有形狀與預張力的驗收紀錄，邊緣夾具與鋼構的接觸面須去除尖角並加保護墊；膜材的耐溫等級、防火性能與更換方法應寫入規格，並在交接時附上分片編號圖。~Every panel needs an acceptance record of shape and pretension, and edge clamps must have sharp edges removed and protective pads against the steel; the temperature rating, fire performance and replacement method of the membranes should be specified, with a panel-numbering plan attached at handover.

units.anchor: 天溝與防蝕塗裝~Gutters and protective coating
units.title: 鋼外殼的防蝕與排水維護~Corrosion protection and drainage of the steel shell
units.mechanism: 鳥巢的鋼構件大部分外露，性能化防火設計只對距觀眾 6 m 內的關鍵屋蓋構件加防火保護，其餘不需被覆，因此塗裝系統同時決定外觀與耐久。天溝構件焊在主桁架上弦，雨水沿鋼構導排；任何積水、焊縫凹處或塗層破損點都會成為腐蝕起點。封閉的箱形桿件內部若有水氣進入，腐蝕將看不到也難以修補，所以箱形斷面的封閉焊接與排水孔設計同樣重要。~Most steel in the Bird's Nest is exposed; performance-based fire design added fire protection only to critical roof members within 6 m of spectators, leaving the rest unprotected, so the coating system governs both appearance and durability. Gutter elements are welded to the top chords of the primary trusses, so rainwater drains along the steel, and any ponding, weld crevice or coating damage becomes a corrosion starting point. If moisture enters sealed box members, corrosion is invisible and hard to repair, so seal welding and drain-hole design of box sections matter as much as the coating.
units.model: 1.2 m 方管每公尺外表面積 4×1.2 = 4.8 m²。若外露桿件總長 36 km，塗裝面積約 4.8×36,000 = 172,800 m²；乾膜厚 240 μm 時乾膜體積 172,800×0.00024 ≈ 41.5 m³，體積固體分 60% 需濕漆約 69 m³，加 30% 損耗約 90 m³。桿件總長與膜厚為教學假設。~A 1.2 m square box has 4×1.2 = 4.8 m² of outer surface per metre. If exposed members total 36 km, the coated area is about 4.8×36,000 = 172,800 m²; at 240 μm dry film the dry volume is 172,800×0.00024 ≈ 41.5 m³, needing about 69 m³ of wet paint at 60% volume solids, or about 90 m³ with 30% losses. Total length and film thickness are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 工廠塗裝以表面處理等級、乾膜厚量測與附著力試驗驗收，現場補漆區另做記錄；使用期間以無人機或繩索檢查天溝積水、塗層粉化與鏽斑，依區域劃分評等；箱形桿件抽查內部濕度或以內視鏡檢查封閉性。~Accept shop coating by surface-preparation grade, dry-film-thickness readings and adhesion tests, recording site touch-up areas separately; in service inspect gutters for ponding and coatings for chalking and rust by drone or rope access, rating by zone; spot-check sealed boxes for internal humidity or with a borescope.
units.failure: 天溝坡度不足或落葉堵塞造成長期積水，積水區塗層先失效，上弦鋼板逐漸減薄；箱形桿件封閉焊接不連續，水氣進入後在內部凝結，鏽蝕膨脹甚至撐裂焊縫，外觀卻看不出異狀。~Gutters with too little fall or blocked by debris hold water for long periods, coatings fail first in the ponded zones and the top-chord plate thins; discontinuous seal welds on box members let moisture in to condense inside, and rust expansion can even split welds while the outside looks normal.
units.misconception: 鋼構表面看起來沒有鏽，就表示整個鋼結構沒有腐蝕。~If the steel surface shows no rust, the whole steel structure is free of corrosion.
units.practice: 維護手冊要附塗裝系統規格、各區膜厚與色號、補漆程序與檢查週期，天溝清潔列為季度工作；任何在鋼構上新增焊接或鑽孔都須經結構工程師核可並恢復防蝕。~The maintenance manual should attach the coating specification, film thickness and colour code by zone, touch-up procedure and inspection intervals, with gutter cleaning as a quarterly task; any new welding or drilling on the steel must be approved by the structural engineer and its corrosion protection restored.

units.anchor: 賽後營運荷載與結構檔案~Post-Games loads and structural records
units.title: 賽後再利用、檢測與工程交接~Post-Games reuse, inspection and engineering handover
units.mechanism: 鳥巢在 2008 年奧運後改為長期場館，座位由奧運時約 91,000 席規劃為約 80,000 席，並於 2022 年再次用於冬奧開閉幕式。賽後活動常在屋蓋吊掛舞台燈光、音響與特效設備，形成原設計以外的集中荷載；看台與場地用途改變也會影響防火情境。因此交接文件必須清楚標示屋蓋可吊掛點、容許荷載與檢查要求，讓營運單位在每次活動前能核對。~After the 2008 Olympics the Bird's Nest became a long-term venue, with capacity planned to drop from about 91,000 Olympic seats to about 80,000, and it hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics ceremonies. Post-Games events often hang stage lighting, sound and special-effects rigs from the roof, creating concentrated loads outside the original design, and changes in seating or field use affect fire scenarios. Handover documents must therefore mark the permitted rigging points, allowable loads and inspection requirements on the roof so that the operator can check them before every event.
units.model: 某演出吊掛設備 60 t，由 6 個吊點平均分擔，每點 F = 60×9.81/6 ≈ 98 kN。若吊點容許荷載為 80 kN，必須增加到 60×9.81/80 ≈ 7.4，即至少 8 個吊點；若吊點分布不均使某點承受 1.5 倍平均值，則需約 147 kN。設備重量與容許荷載為教學假設。~A show rig of 60 t shared equally by 6 points loads each with F = 60×9.81/6 ≈ 98 kN. If the allowable point load is 80 kN, at least 60×9.81/80 ≈ 7.4, that is 8 points, are needed; if uneven distribution gives one point 1.5 times the average, it carries about 147 kN. Rig weight and allowable load are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每場活動的吊掛計畫須列出吊點位置、荷載、動態係數與吊具，由結構工程師依交接的吊點容量表審核；活動後目視檢查吊點與塗層，並定期以監測資料或全測站比對屋蓋關鍵節點位置與卸載後基準。~Each event's rigging plan must list point locations, loads, dynamic factors and rigging gear, reviewed by a structural engineer against the handed-over rigging-capacity table; after the event visually inspect the points and coatings, and periodically compare key roof node positions with the post-unloading baseline by monitoring data or total-station survey.
units.failure: 活動承包商自行在桿件上綁吊或焊接吊耳，造成未經核算的局部彎曲與塗層破壞；多場活動累積的吊掛與拆卸若沒有紀錄，屋蓋在不知情下承受反覆集中荷載，日後無法追溯損傷來源。~Event contractors who sling from members or weld lifting lugs on their own create unchecked local bending and coating damage; without records of repeated rigging and dismantling, the roof carries repeated concentrated loads unknowingly and damage cannot later be traced to its source.
units.misconception: 鋼屋蓋很大很強，吊掛幾十噸的舞台設備不必另外核算。~A large steel roof is so strong that hanging tens of tonnes of stage equipment needs no separate check.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含屋蓋吊點平面與容量表、卸載後幾何基準、監測點位置與資料格式、防火性能化設計的前提條件；任何改變吊點、看台配置或場地用途的計畫，須先經結構與消防顧問評估再核准。~Handover should include a roof rigging-point plan and capacity table, the post-unloading geometric baseline, monitoring point locations and data format, and the assumptions behind the performance-based fire design; any plan that changes rigging points, seating layout or field use must be assessed by structural and fire consultants before approval.

example: 設計練習：估算屋蓋卸載時一個支撐點的反力變化。假設主桁架與環桁架在卸載前總重 30,000 t，由 78 個臨時支撐點承托，平均反力 R̄ = 30,000×9.81/78 ≈ 3,770 kN。該點預測卸載總下沉 270 mm，分 10 級、每級 27 mm；桁架在該點的勁度 k = 15 kN/mm。若千斤頂操作落後一級，附加反力 ΔR = 15×27 = 405 kN，約為 R̄ 的 10.7%；若落後兩級，ΔR = 810 kN，約 21%，已超過常見的 10% 停止門檻。若把每級改為 13.5 mm（20 級），同樣落後一級只增加約 203 kN，約 5.4%。這說明級數越多、單級位移越小，對同步誤差越不敏感，但卸載時間會加倍。所有數值為教學假設，不代表北京國家體育場的實際施工數據。~Design exercise: estimate the change in one support reaction during roof unloading. Assume the primary and ring trusses weigh 30,000 t before unloading, carried by 78 temporary support points, so the mean reaction is R̄ = 30,000×9.81/78 ≈ 3,770 kN. The point is predicted to settle 270 mm in total, unloaded in 10 stages of 27 mm, and the truss stiffness there is k = 15 kN/mm. If its jack lags one stage, the added reaction is ΔR = 15×27 = 405 kN, about 10.7% of R̄; lagging two stages gives ΔR = 810 kN, about 21%, beyond a typical 10% stop threshold. Using 13.5 mm stages (20 stages), the same one-stage lag adds only about 203 kN, about 5.4%. More, smaller stages make unloading less sensitive to synchronisation error, at the cost of doubling its duration. All values are teaching assumptions, not actual construction data of the Beijing National Stadium.
history: 北京國家體育場由 Herzog & de Meuron 與中國建築設計研究院合作設計，Arup 擔任結構與機電顧問，2002 至 2003 年競圖勝出後於 2003 年 12 月 24 日奠基。原方案含可開合屋頂，2004 年 6 月因鋼材成本與預算壓力取消，屋蓋開口隨之加大、用鋼量下降；主結構為交織的 12 m 深平面桁架，以 24 組桁架柱支承，設計採三級性能化耐震與性能化防火。體育場於 2008 年完工，作為北京奧運主場館，2022 年再次用於冬奧開閉幕式。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~The Beijing National Stadium was designed by Herzog & de Meuron with China Architecture Design & Research Group, with Arup as structural and building-services engineer; after winning the 2002–2003 competition the foundation stone was laid on 24 December 2003. The original scheme included a retractable roof, dropped in June 2004 because of steel costs and budget pressure, which enlarged the roof opening and reduced steel; the primary structure is a set of interlaced 12 m deep plane trusses on 24 column trusses, designed with three-level performance-based seismic design and performance-based fire engineering. Completed in 2008 as the main venue of the Beijing Olympics, it hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics ceremonies. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
